effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 2 of their Digimon gain "[On Deletion] Lose 1 memory." Then, if [WarGrowlmon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, you may choose any number of your opponent's Digimon whose total DP adds up to 6000 or less and delete them.
